title: ztunes
tagline: Pandora for music NFT's. Listen to random songs from the decentralized web.
description: Small webapp where I pulled data from Neume to generate a random playlist of music NFT's that can be listened to through your browser. I initially wanted to do some data analysis and try to find hot or trending music NFT's, but there simply doesn't seem to be enough info to do that. This is also a first step in hopefully being able to collect more data about what types of music NFT's people are interested in as I plan to add some social features like "likes" and sharing.
how_its_made:
Built heavily on top of @dhaiwat10's NFT explorer tutorial.
I used Zora API's, neume, pull music and pull music and images from IPFS.

I used Python and Jupyter to load neume data and explore it a bit in a notebook, before processing it to generate a playlist. I also played around alot with Zora GraphQL API's to try to find interested data to rank music NFT's by, but it didn't prove fruitful. The Neuma data was very easy to use though.
